$comment: Studio Office (mockup 06). 'crop' is the context Codex sees; each target's 'box' bounds what it removes. Agents and helpers become cut-outs of the mockup's own pixels; 'interface' targets are the mockup's UI painted over the room, removed for good. 'floorY' orders overlapping agents (front first). An agent's 'outfit' redresses their cut-out to match their theme portrait (JARVIS wears his tweed jacket, not the apron the mockup paints). Every rect is [x0, y0, x1, y1) in mockup pixels.
